sections.title: Comprehension and Summary
objectives: Identify main points/topic sentences in passages
Identify the grammatical functions of words, phrases, clauses and figurative/idiomatic expressions
Deduce or infer the writer's intentions including mood, attitude to the subject matter and opinion
Comprehension of the whole or part of each passage
Comprehension of words, phrases, clauses, sentences, figures of speech and idioms as used in the passages
Coherence and logical reasoning (deductions, inferences, etc.)
Synthesis of ideas from the passages
notes: Each of the three passages to be set (one will be a cloze test) should reflect various disciplines and be about 200 words long.
Synthesis of ideas means the art of combining distinct or separate pieces of information to form a complete whole as summary.

sections.title: Lexis and Structure
topics: Mood, tense, aspect, number, agreement/concord, degree (positive, comparative and superlative) and question tags
Ordinary usage, figurative usage and idiomatic usage
objectives: Identify words and expressions in their figurative and idiomatic contexts
Determine similar and opposite meanings of words
Differentiate between correct and incorrect spellings
Identify various grammatical patterns in use
notes: Idioms to be tested are those that are formal and expressed in Standard British English (SBE).

sections.title: Oral Forms
objectives: Identify correct pronunciation of individual words and articulation of connected speech
notes: Emphatic stress involves the placement of stress on words in an utterance for the purpose of emphasis.

source: JAMB UTME Use of English Syllabus
